description: This Java source file implements the <while> element for a mini-language used within the OFBiz framework. It defines the While class, which represents a while loop construct that executes a set of operations while a condition is true, and a factory class for creating instances of While.

classes.name: While
classes.description: Represents a while loop construct in the mini-language, with a condition and a list of sub-operations to execute repeatedly.

classes.name: WhileFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating While instances from XML elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the while loop, repeatedly evaluating the condition and executing sub-operations until the condition evaluates to false or an exception controls the flow.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information from sub-operations for analysis.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the While object, including its condition.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method for creating a new While object from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for the factory ('while').
